productivebeesgenesis.configuration.term: Magnet filter mode
Defaults to All. Allow list attracts only listed items; an empty allow list attracts nothing. Deny list skips listed items. Matches registry IDs and all their component variants.
Magnet item list

Up to 16 full item IDs, each at most 128 characters, e.g. minecraft:cobblestone. No tags or wildcards. All ignores the list; an empty deny list allows everything. New rows default to cobblestone and can be edited or removed.
Pickup deposit filter mode

Defaults to All. Allow list deposits only listed items; an empty allow list deposits nothing. Deny list keeps listed items in your inventory. Matches registry IDs and all component variants; normal pickup is preserved.
Pickup deposit item list

Up to 16 full item IDs, each at most 128 characters, e.g. minecraft:cobblestone. Separate from the magnet list. No tags or wildcards. All ignores the list; an empty deny list allows everything. New rows default to cobblestone and can be edited or removed.

productivebeesgenesis.configuration.term: Wireless magnet

Disabled by default. Use an inventory/offhand wireless device to attract visible ordinary item drops within 4 blocks when they fit in the main inventory. Each pulse attracts up to 4 entities and costs wireless command energy, subject to shared server budgets. Sneak or open a screen to pause. Depositing pickups into ME has a separate setting.

productivebeesgenesis.configuration.term: Store picked-up items in ME

Disabled by default. After a normal pickup into the 36 main inventory slots, use an inventory/offhand wireless device to deposit up to one stack (at most 64) into its bound ME network. Requires an unchanged inventory and wireless command energy. Unavailable budget or connection keeps vanilla pickup; rejected items return to the inventory or terminal custody. Does not attract items or bypass inventory space and pickup protection.

productivebeesgenesis.configuration.term: Remember empty-slot refills

Disabled by default. While wireless ME restocking is enabled, the server remembers component-exact samples observed in each slot during this session, then refills empty slots to the target. Includes the enabled offhand; initially empty slots have no template. Screens, pauses, device or preference changes and disconnections clear templates. A new session learns current items; templates are not saved across logins.

productivebeesgenesis.configuration.term: Wireless ME restocking

Disabled by default. Uses an inventory/offhand wireless terminal to refill existing stacks to the target (64 by default, limited by the item stack size), delivering into the original slot. Offhand refills can be enabled separately. Checks once per second with backoff; extraction costs wireless command energy. Pauses with screens open. Empty slots can use session templates. No armor refills or automatic crafting.
Restock target amount
Target for each existing stack, from 1 to 64; defaults to 64 and respects the item's stack limit. Existing amounts above the target are kept. Empty slots use the separate template setting.
Restock offhand items

Disabled by default. While wireless ME restocking is enabled, also refill the existing offhand stack to the same target. Preserves exact components and delivers into the original offhand slot. Wireless devices and armor are excluded; empty slots use the separate template setting.

productivebeesgenesis.configuration.term: Wireless ME pick block

Disabled by default. In the world, pick a block missing from your inventory to retrieve up to one stack from the bound ME network through the first usable wireless terminal in your inventory or offhand. Targets must be within interaction reach, at most 8 blocks; the path and host must be loaded. Picking and plan actions use wireless energy fees. If no items can be taken, opens a crafting plan for up to one stack. Confirm to order; outputs go to ME storage.

productivebeesgenesis.configuration.term: Pin completed ME outputs

Disabled by default. Moves up to 9 recently completed outputs of your jobs to the front of the current ME network's filtered results while stock remains. Pins last 10 minutes; search and type filters still apply. Leaving the server clears the history.

Disabled by default. Returns crafting materials to your inventory when you close the terminal; excess stays in the grid. Requires the account owner to be its only viewer with no pending action. Switching pages or disconnecting does not trigger a return.

Disabled by default. Shows completion notifications for your ME jobs without requiring an AE2 wireless terminal, including after leaving the task page. Disabling preserves AE2's original notification settings.

productivebeesgenesis.configuration.bala: These rules apply directly only when the global balance profile is Custom.

Open the balance profile list. Switching profiles never removes installed upgrades.

To configure upgrade limits or balance rules independently, first switch to Custom and save, then edit the individual settings. Switching to Custom inherits the previously effective preset values.

Productivity and speed tiers are mutually exclusive. Centrifuge productivity upgrades add parallel processing only. Apiaries obey bee behavior and weather-tolerance genes. Default Productive Bees and centrifuge stack limits are 4 and 8. Closer to the original feel of Mekanism and Productive Bees, but still far from the true power of the Myriad Creations Bee.

Productivity and speed tiers can coexist. Centrifuge productivity upgrades increase both output and parallel processing. Apiaries ignore bee behavior and weather-tolerance genes, and multi-flower bees produce from every distinct valid feeder source each cycle. Default Productive Bees and centrifuge stack limits are 8 and 16. Blessed by the Myriad Creations Bee, the Productive Bees upgrades reclaim part of their rightful power.
Use the individual rules and limits below. Switching from Basic or Paradox Infinity inherits the previously effective settings.

Prevent alpha, beta, gamma, and omega productivity upgrades from coexisting in one machine.

The global balance preset can override this value in Basic/Paradox Infinity mode. First switch Gameplay Settings > Global Balance Profile to Custom and save, then return to edit and save this setting. Switching to Custom inherits the previously effective preset values.

Prevent TIME and TIME_2 upgrades from coexisting in one machine.

The global balance preset can override this value in Basic/Paradox Infinity mode. First switch Gameplay Settings > Global Balance Profile to Custom and save, then return to edit and save this setting. Switching to Custom inherits the previously effective preset values.

Also multiply centrifuge output quantity. Productive Bees parallel processing remains active when disabled.

The global balance preset can override this value in Basic/Paradox Infinity mode. First switch Gameplay Settings > Global Balance Profile to Custom and save, then return to edit and save this setting. Switching to Custom inherits the previously effective preset values.

Lumber, quarry and dye bees produce from every distinct valid feeder source each cycle. Duplicate slots and stack size add no extra rolls; disabled slots and the duplication blacklist still apply. When off, one source is selected at random. Off in Basic and fresh Custom settings; on in Paradox Infinity.

To edit independently, switch Gameplay Settings > Global Balance Profile to Custom and save first. Switching to Custom inherits the previously effective preset values.

Pause each bee when its behavior or weather-tolerance gene does not permit work under the current time and weather.

The global balance preset can override this value in Basic/Paradox Infinity mode. First switch Gameplay Settings > Global Balance Profile to Custom and save, then return to edit and save this setting. Switching to Custom inherits the previously effective preset values.
